title: Project event tags and issue association semantics
description:
The event stream has a finite source-defined tag vocabulary, but no maintained projection records event tags or which events carry an `issue_id`.

Source: `crates/jit/src/domain/types.rs:1305-1581,1981-2031`; `crates/jit/src/storage/json.rs:735-775`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A generated machine-consumable and documentation-friendly surface lists every event tag and its association scope, including `issue_id` presence.
- [hard] REQ-02: The no-issue set correctly includes `document_archived`, gate-definition events, and `lifecycle_timestamps_backfilled`.
- [hard] REQ-03: Automated coverage fails when an Event change leaves the catalog stale.
